patterns.condition: Designing the gather, craft, build, survive cycle
patterns.action: Make better tools reach new resources, which unlock better crafts. When that ladder breaks the game turns into a grind.
patterns.statement: Each loop must open the next one

patterns.condition: Adding hunger, thirst, cold or stamina
patterns.action: Warn first, then drain health over time, and let health recover when the player is fed and safe. Instant death from a need pushes players to quit.
patterns.statement: Needs should hurt slowly, not kill instantly

patterns.condition: Draining a need or a timer in Verse
patterns.action: Drain by elapsed seconds in a loop with Sleep so the rate is the same for every player and every server load.
patterns.statement: Scale every decay by time, not by frames

patterns.action: Check the inputs and the room for the result first, then take the inputs and give the output as one step, so a full inventory never eats materials.
patterns.statement: Crafting must be all or nothing

patterns.action: Require a tool tier for better nodes, so a stronger tool is the reason to explore farther.
Respawn nodes after a delay or regenerate them over time, so late players still have something to gather.
patterns.statement: Do not strip the world permanently

patterns.action: Cap slots or weight so storage and return trips matter, otherwise there is no reason to build a base.
patterns.statement: Limit the inventory so a base matters

patterns.action: Escalate with night, season or event tiers so late play is under pressure, and give a calm period after each peak.

patterns.condition: A large world or base to remember
patterns.action: Save inventory, base and needs at safe moments with a version number, so a crash or an update does not wipe hours of play.
patterns.statement: Save in steps and keep a version

patterns.condition: A crafting tree with many steps
patterns.action: Show the next unlock or a simple recipe list on screen, so players are never guessing what to gather.
patterns.statement: Tell the player what the next goal is
